messages:
Marie Liu: heads up — after the launch post at 09:00 we see a 3x inbound spike but the CRM leads count is lagging vs. Pulseboard. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch-overview :thinking:
launchbot: automated alert: inbound_leads > 2.5 * rolling_avg in last 30m — triggered at 09:12 UTC
Josh Patel: seeing same. Pulseboard shows 420 leads, CRM shows 282. are we double-counting sessions or missing partner UTMs? :mag_right:
Anya Gomez: can someone paste the top traffic sources? my guess is organic + syndication — might be UTM param inconsistency from the partner widget
Sam Kim: quick SQL I ran on raw_events: ```select source, utm_medium, count(distinct anonymous_id) as cnt from raw_events where event='signup' and ts between '2026-03-22 08:45' and '2026-03-22 09:30' group by 1,2 order by 3 desc limit 10;``` returns a big chunk labeled `referral` (no UTM) — probably the partner redirect dropping params
Marie Liu: ugh. that explains mismatched attribution. but product wants handwritten weekly kpi deck numbers — which do we present? Pulseboard (session deduped) or CRM (converted, but delayed)?
Josh Patel: short answer: show both. primary KPI = CRM-converted leads (final SLO), secondary = session-based inbound (early signal). note the difference in the deck with a one-line footnote about UTMs/partner funnel issues
Anya Gomez: agree. i'll add a slide with timeline + anomaly annotation. also propose a short remediation plan: 1) flag partner for UTM fix, 2) keep CRM sync job running hourly, 3) add a transient alert to catch large session->CRM deltas
Sam Kim: for the deck numbers i can produce a reconciled row: ``reconciled_leads = crm_leads + (pulse_sessions_without_utm * conversion_rate_estimate)`` — can run with conservative 8% conv estimate and include uncertainty band
Marie Liu: perfect. can you run that and drop the table in the weekly KPI deck by 11:30? we present the live readout at 12:00 PM standup
Josh Patel: FYI i checked the sampling config — no sampling change. so it's not instrumentation sampling noise
Anya Gomez: tagging the partner contact in email thread now. also adding an annotation to the Pulseboard chart so later review isn't noisy :memo:
launchbot: action created — task/marketing/5472 "Investigate partner UTM dropping on redirect" assigned to Anya Gomez, due 2026-03-23
Marie Liu: thanks team. last ask — please include a one-liner in the kpi slide clarifying which metric is used for MQL vs. early signal. avoids future attribution debates. :pray:
